title: Rav Yosef bar Dosai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Chullin 49a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.49a.10), disputing with the sages. Hyman reports the Dikdukei Soferim reading Abba Yose ben Dostai, whom Hyman places among the last Tannaim, as explained in his entry.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Chullin explicitly names Rav Yosef bar Dosai. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2036&lang=en) directs readers to Abba Yose ben Dostai. Hyman reports the latter as the Dikdukei Soferim reading and places him among the last Tannaim.
Chullin 49a follows the printed מט. locator. The supplied text ends with a comma; that punctuation alone does not establish that further words are missing.
